origin.description: Replace named variables in a Makevars file and write the result.
origin.details: A name that appears once is replaced. A name that is absent is appended. Two matches for one name are an error. The file is left untouched when the text would not change.
origin.value: The previous lines, or NULL when there was no file.
origin.example:
old <- tempfile()
writeLines("CFLAGS = -O2", old)
new <- tempfile()
set_makevars(c(CFLAGS = "-O3", PKG_LIBS = "-lm"), old, new)
readLines(new)

translation.description: Replace named variables in a Makevars file and write the result.
translation.details: A name that appears once is replaced. A name that is absent is appended. Two matches for one name are an error. The file is left untouched when the text would not change.
translation.value: The previous lines, or NULL when there was no file.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

fd, old = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
fd, new = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
with open(old, "w") as handle:
    handle.write("CFLAGS = -O2\n")
set_makevars({"CFLAGS": "-O3", "PKG_LIBS": "-lm"}, old, new)
with open(new) as handle:
    lines = handle.read().splitlines()
os.remove(old)
os.remove(new)
return lines
